SELECT fiscal_year, min(calendar_date) AS d0, max(calendar_date) AS d1, min(fiscal_week), max(fiscal_week), count(*) AS days
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_week <= 22 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_region AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, count(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d  ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week <= 22
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT region, fiscal_year, ROUND(net_sales,2) AS net_sales, stores FROM by_region ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, net_sales DESC

SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),2) AS control_net_sales, count(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS stores
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = r.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week <= 22 AND r.store_id < 900
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 3 DESC

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cs.region, cs.store_id, cs.store_name,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN n.net_sales END),0) AS ty,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN n.net_sales END),0) AS ly
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week <= 22
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_region AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week <= 22
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS rank, region, fiscal_year, net_sales
FROM by_region
ORDER BY rank
